premise.claim: Docs-only PR (8 markdown files, no production code): adds the English and Chinese manual v1alpha1-to-v1alpha2 migration guides plus cross-links. Slice 3 of the v1alpha1 deprecation split (1: admission gate #524, 2: chart+gate docs #552, 3: migration guides, 4: webhook removal #556).
premise.reportedComponent: documentation (doc/, READMEs, chart README, release checklist)
premise.evidence: Docs/tests-only PR: premise validation and P0 reproduction are carved out per the review rubric. The premise reviewed instead is content accuracy: every behavioral claim in the guides was traced to code on the PR head (see README table).

findings.note: Doc-contract test: RED on the PR head (reproduction — the Rollback section claims the validator rejects an InstanceSet restore, which it does not); GREEN once both guides stop making that claim. Code-pin evidence: TestMigrationGuide_RollbackRestore_InstanceSetNotRejectedByValidator (canary on the code side, documents that the write is accepted today).
Pins the guide's accurate claim: restoring a Deployment/StatefulSet/LeaderWorkerSet selector after migration is rejected even with compat enabled.
Pins the guide's type-exact compatibility claim (same type kept = accepted; switch between deprecated types = rejected).

standaloneChecks.note: The guide's role-inventory jq command (identical copy in chart README) run against fixtures covering all four role-location shapes, positive selectors, the v1alpha1 workload-field precedence over a stale annotation, and negative controls. Runs standalone; not part of the gotest layer.

liveNote: L3 (live cluster) skipped per round policy: unit + integration layers only. The kubectl commands in the guide (get/replace/patch with fully-qualified v1alpha2 resources, CRD status.storedVersions subresource patch) were validated against the repo's CRD manifests and kubectl semantics by inspection; the jq pipeline is covered deterministically by the GUIDE-INVENTORY-JQ standalone check above.
